description: A cozy, lived-in sitting room corner at evening or dusk with warm amber tones dominating the atmosphere. A rustic solid-wood trestle table with sawhorse-style legs in aged honey-brown occupies the right foreground, its surface holding a collection of potted plants — a fern and terracotta pots of varying sizes — a small wooden bowl, and a vintage alarm clock. On the table sits a rounded dome form in pale yellow-cream glass or ceramic on a warm wood base, emitting a warm golden glow that radiates outward across the table surface and wall. Behind the table, the plaster wall is a warm honey-beige. To the left, a wide dark-framed window or glass door panel reveals a dusky blue-green outdoor garden view with warm spots of exterior illumination filtering through the glass. Beside the window, a low upholstered accent chair in oatmeal or cream textured fabric sits with a chunky knit throw draped casually over one arm. A natural fiber jute rug in a neutral tan anchors the floor. The overall mood is deeply warm, domestic, and intimate — a room fully inhabited at the close of day. Camera at seated to standing eye-level, three-quarter corner composition showing both the table vignette and the seating area, normal lens, level pitch. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
